title: tunnel_authorization vector generator refuses to run in this workspace: 'atomic JSON parent directory is unsafe' — test_tunnel_authorization_generator_is_fresh fails pre-existing
description: Discovered while validating 5rfl. python/tests/gateway/test_tunnel_auth_vectors.py::test_tunnel_authorization_generator_is_fresh fails on a clean tree (verified via git stash): python/test/vectors/generate_tunnel_authorization.py --check exits 2 with 'cannot safely read tunnel_authorization.json: atomic JSON parent directory is unsafe'. The generator's atomic-write safety check rejects this checkout's parent-directory permissions, so the freshness gate cannot pass in this environment. Also noted: the python/.venv was missing declared dev deps (hypothesis, pytest-asyncio, jsonschema, ruff, mypy — installed via uv this session), suggesting tests are usually run elsewhere; either the safety check is too strict for workspace layouts or the test needs a skip/env guard. Investigate the check's criteria and make the generator usable in worker workspaces without weakening its write-safety intent.
close_reason: Root cause: _open_owned_directory rejected any group-writable parent; worker workspaces run umask 002 (g+w dirs), so the generator refused and the freshness test failed. Fix (test/vectors/atomic_json.py): parent check now accepts a group-writable dir only when the user-private-group convention is VERIFIED — group resolves to the owner's name, gr_mem has no extra members, no enumerated account carries the gid as primary group; other-writable stays fatal, unresolvable names fail closed, verdicts memoized per (uid,gid). Reviewer-driven corrections during the round: name-only match tightened to membership verification after security pass; docstring states the honest getpwall() enumeration limit (NSS enumerate=false hosts: primary-gid leg is best-effort); reject-test skip predicate polarity fixed and predicates now reuse the module's own criterion via _directory_group_is_owner_only. Tests: accept/reject paths are complementary per host; world-writable rejection is host-independent. This host: group 'mark' has member langwei, so the check correctly STILL refuses it (write-safety intact — vectors here would be tamperable by a non-owner); test_tunnel_authorization_generator_is_fresh now skips with that precise reason instead of failing (rc==2 'cannot safely read' only; rc==1 staleness still fails). Regenerating vectors on this host requires the admin to drop the extra group member or chmod g-w. Suites: atomic_json 45/1, gateway 315/4, ruff+mypy clean. 3 reviewer passes (kimi-k3): correctness PASS; security 2 findings fixed; edge 3 findings fixed.
